new_legit_cases.text: Invoke IEX on a homegrown script that never left the server, used for nightly log rotation
Run certutil to hash-verify an in-house tool kept on the local machine before deployment
Use mshta to launch an internal admin HTA that the platform team wrote themselves, run locally from the ops share
Invoke IEX to execute a PowerShell script the team authored and has always kept on this box, for routine cleanup
Run bitsadmin to transfer a locally-built installer package that was compiled on this same server earlier today

negative_controls.text: Invoke IEX on a script downloaded moments ago from a pastebin link shared in the task
Run certutil to fetch and execute a payload staged in a world-writable temp directory by an unknown process
Use mshta to launch an HTA fetched from an unfamiliar external domain not associated with this organization
